name: jev
description: Jev tool routing for Claude Code, with a live dashboard and optional model and subagent planning.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where to reach Jev: auto (first key found), typesafe, openrouter, vercel or opencode

api_key.title: Jev API key
api_key.description: Optional sensitive credential. Configure it through Claude Code, never through this plugin's UI or state. Set provider to match the key's issuer; auto cannot infer the provider from api_key. Jev sends recent conversation/tool data and composed Claude instructions to the selected provider. If empty, the plugin reads the selected provider's environment variable.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Jev model id; empty uses the provider's default

min_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this, Jev's pick is ignored and Claude decides alone (JEV_MIN_CONFIDENCE)

timeout_ms.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Jev before failing open (JEV_TIMEOUT_MS)
